title: Esmeralda catalog snapshot
description: What `esmeralda catalog fetch` read from one external catalog source for one environment, normalized: catalog/snapshots/<source>/<env>.json (or the source's options.snapshot). `esmeralda catalog resolve` reads only snapshots, never the live system, so it needs no network and its output is reproducible; every external change reaches the catalog through a reviewed snapshot change. A snapshot carries no wall-clock value (Git history has the date) and no environment-specific literal: project ids and numbers, the organization id, the domain and the region are placeholders. Changes are additive only; only a breaking change bumps `schema_version`.

source.description: Name of the source in catalog/sources.yaml.

type.description: Source type (agent_registry, project_labels, backstage, or a registered adapter).

fetched_by.description: The command that writes this file: esmeralda catalog fetch --env <env> --source <source>.

entries.description: Normalized entries, sorted by id. Their other fields depend on the source type.

id.description: Stable id of the entry in its source (adoption pins match on it).

name.description: Deterministic catalog name derived at fetch time.
